attempts.summary: Configured node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 via root's crontab, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. The script file found on disk was corrupted (contained a leftover heredoc delimiter and stray shell commands as literal text instead of being executable), so it was rewritten as a clean POSIX sh script and made executable (0755, root:root) before installing the cron entry. Verified the full pipeline end-to-end, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a pre-restart boot_id baseline, issued a self-acknowledging systemctl reboot, polled until exec access returned, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified crond, the crontab entry, the executable script, and the log file all survived and functioned correctly post-restart.
